plugins.name: missing-manual-creator
plugins.description: Generates learning materials (tutorials, methodology guides, study notes, cheat sheets) following the Missing Manual principles: pyramid structure, term proximity, contextual depth, and laconic practicality.

plugins.name: pdf-marks
plugins.description: Puts the marks a paper document carries onto a PDF: a stored handwritten signature and a company seal, both anchored to the signature block automatically, with a preview crop for visual check.
